sections.verified:
- The math-heavy Section 3.5 QTI can be rendered into clean prompt images from the cartridge.
- WIRIS JSON annotations no longer leak into rendered prompt images.
- MathML `mfenced` is normalized so Chrome screenshots show parentheses.
- Multiple-choice answer choices can be embedded inside the prompt image while the actual Google Forms controls use `A`, `B`, `C`, `D`.
- The live Google Forms bridge accepted the rendered images and controls.
sections.weakProvisional:
- This is still a proof script, not a polished batch cartridge converter.
- Browser rendering depends on a local Chrome executable or `CHROME_PATH`.
- More MathML constructs may need normalization after testing broader quizzes.
- The proof script and test are untracked and not committed.
sections.unverified:
- Full-course batch conversion across all 78 QTI assessments.
- Every item type and every math/image combination in the cartridge.
- User-side visual inspection of the live Google Form.
sections.risks:
- Some older MathML/WIRIS output may use constructs Chrome does not render natively.
- Very long questions may need a taller browser screenshot viewport or per-question height handling.
- If this becomes the main route, it should be promoted from proof script to a documented batch command.
